name: Turn (Left)
meaning: The road ahead turns sharply to the left (Turn signs are used where the recommended speed is 30 mph or less); slow down before the turn.

name: Turn (Right)
meaning: The road ahead turns sharply to the right (Turn signs are used where the recommended speed is 30 mph or less); slow down before the turn.

name: Curve (Left)
meaning: The road ahead curves to the left; reduce speed and stay in your lane through the curve.

name: Curve (Right)
meaning: The road ahead curves to the right; reduce speed and stay in your lane through the curve.

name: Reverse Turn (Right then Left)
meaning: The road ahead turns sharply to the right and then sharply back to the left; slow down before the first turn.

name: Reverse Curve (Right then Left)
meaning: The road ahead curves to the right and then back to the left; slow down and stay in your lane.

name: Winding Road
meaning: A series of three or more curves is ahead; slow down and stay in your lane until the road straightens out.

name: One-Direction Large Arrow (Right)
meaning: Posted on the outside of a sharp turn, the arrow shows that the road turns to the right; slow down and follow the arrow.

name: Two-Direction Large Arrow
meaning: Posted across the end of a T-intersection, it warns that the road ends and you must turn either left or right.

name: Chevron Alignment (Right)
meaning: Chevrons are posted along the outside of a sharp curve to guide you through it; they point in the direction the road curves (here, to the right).

name: Curve with Advisory Speed (Right)
meaning: The road curves to the right ahead, and the speed shown inside the sign is the recommended maximum speed for the curve.

name: Cross Road (Intersection Ahead)
meaning: A crossroad intersection is ahead; watch for vehicles entering or crossing from the side roads.

name: Side Road (Right)
meaning: A side road enters from the right ahead; watch for vehicles entering, turning, or slowing.

name: T Intersection
meaning: The road you are on ends at a T-intersection ahead; slow down and prepare to turn left or right, yielding or stopping as required.

name: Y Intersection
meaning: The road ahead splits into a Y; slow down and prepare to bear left or right.

name: Circular Intersection (Roundabout Ahead)
meaning: A roundabout or traffic circle is ahead; slow down, yield to traffic already circulating, and travel counterclockwise around the center island.

name: Stop Ahead
meaning: A STOP sign is ahead and may be hard to see; slow down and be prepared to stop.

name: Yield Ahead
meaning: A YIELD sign is ahead; slow down and be prepared to yield or stop.

name: Signal Ahead
meaning: A traffic signal is ahead and may be hidden by a curve or hill; slow down and be prepared to stop.

name: Be Prepared to Stop
meaning: Traffic ahead may be stopped or backed up; slow down and be ready to stop.

name: Reduced Speed Limit Ahead
meaning: The speed limit drops ahead; begin slowing so you are at or below the new limit when you reach it.

name: Merge (From Right)
meaning: Traffic from another roadway or lane will merge into your lane from the right ahead; watch for merging vehicles and adjust your speed to let them in.

name: Lane Ends (Right Lane)
meaning: The right lane ends ahead; drivers in that lane must merge left, and drivers in the other lane should let them merge.

name: Added Lane (From Right)
meaning: A roadway joins from the right and continues as its own added lane, so entering traffic does not have to merge; watch for vehicles entering.

name: Cross Traffic Does Not Stop (Plaque)
meaning: Mounted below a STOP sign, it warns that traffic on the cross street does not stop, so wait for a safe gap before entering or crossing.

name: Right Lane Ends
meaning: The right lane ends ahead; if you are in it, merge left safely, and other drivers should let merging vehicles in.

name: Road Narrows
meaning: The pavement ahead narrows so that opposing vehicles may not be able to pass each other at normal speed; slow down and use caution.

name: Narrow Bridge
meaning: A bridge ahead is narrower than the road leading to it; slow down and watch for oncoming vehicles.

name: One Lane Bridge
meaning: The bridge ahead has only one lane for both directions; slow down and yield to vehicles already on or about to enter the bridge.

name: Divided Highway Begins
meaning: The road ahead becomes a divided highway with a median separating the two directions of travel; keep to the right of the median.

name: Divided Highway Ends
meaning: The divided highway ends ahead and opposing traffic will no longer be separated by a median; keep right and watch for oncoming vehicles.

name: Two-Way Traffic
meaning: Traffic ahead travels in both directions on the same roadway; keep to the right and watch for oncoming vehicles.

name: Hill (Steep Downgrade)
meaning: A steep downgrade is ahead; check your brakes, slow down, and use a lower gear to control your speed (especially in trucks).

name: Bump
meaning: A sharp rise or bump in the road surface is ahead; slow down to keep control of your vehicle.

name: Dip
meaning: A sharp dip or low spot in the road surface is ahead; slow down to keep control of your vehicle.

name: Pavement Ends
meaning: The paved surface ends ahead and the road becomes gravel or dirt; slow down.

name: Soft Shoulder
meaning: The shoulder beside the road is soft and may not support a vehicle; stay on the pavement except in an emergency.

name: Slippery When Wet
meaning: The road becomes slippery when wet; in wet weather slow down, increase following distance, and avoid sudden braking or sharp steering.

name: Loose Gravel
meaning: Loose gravel on the road surface ahead reduces traction; slow down and avoid sudden braking or steering.

name: Low Shoulder
meaning: The shoulder is lower than the edge of the pavement; if your wheels drop off the road, slow down and ease back onto the pavement gradually.

name: Bridge Ices Before Road
meaning: In cold weather the bridge surface can freeze before the rest of the road; slow down and avoid sudden braking or steering on the bridge.

name: Fallen Rocks
meaning: Rocks may have fallen onto the road from the slope above; watch for rocks on the roadway and be ready to stop or steer around them safely.

name: Bicycle Warning
meaning: Watch for bicyclists entering, crossing, or riding along the roadway ahead, and give them plenty of room when passing.

name: Pedestrian Warning
meaning: Watch for pedestrians crossing or walking in the roadway ahead, and be prepared to yield to them.

name: Deer Crossing
meaning: Deer often cross the road in this area; slow down and stay alert, especially at dawn and dusk.

name: Cattle Crossing
meaning: Cattle may cross or be standing on the roadway ahead; slow down and watch for livestock.

name: Farm Vehicle
meaning: Slow-moving farm machinery such as tractors may enter, cross, or travel on the road ahead; slow down and pass only when it is safe.

name: Equestrian (Horse and Rider)
meaning: Horseback riders may cross or travel along the road ahead; slow down, give them room, and avoid honking or sudden noises.

name: Emergency Vehicle
meaning: Emergency vehicles such as fire trucks may enter the roadway ahead (for example from a fire station); watch for them and yield.

name: Truck Crossing
meaning: Trucks may be entering or crossing the road ahead; watch for large, slow-moving vehicles.

name: Horse-Drawn Vehicle
meaning: Slow-moving horse-drawn vehicles such as buggies may be on the road ahead; slow down and pass with plenty of room.

name: Trail Crossing (Bicycles and Pedestrians)
meaning: A shared-use trail used by bicyclists and pedestrians crosses the road ahead; watch for trail users and be prepared to yield.

name: Double Arrow (Pass Either Side)
meaning: An obstruction such as a median island or bridge pier is in the road ahead, and traffic may pass on either side of it.

name: Low Clearance
meaning: An overpass or other overhead structure ahead has limited clearance (height shown); vehicles taller than the posted height must not go under it.

name: Advisory Speed (Plaque)
meaning: Mounted below a warning sign, it shows the recommended maximum speed for the curve or condition ahead.

name: Exit Advisory Speed
meaning: Posted where a freeway exit ramp begins, it shows the recommended maximum speed for the exit; slow to that speed after leaving the through lanes.

name: Dead End
meaning: The street ahead dead-ends with no way through; you will have to turn around to leave.

name: No Outlet
meaning: The road or road network ahead has no other exit, so you will have to leave the same way you came in.

name: No Passing Zone
meaning: Posted on the left side of the road, this pennant marks the beginning of a no-passing zone; do not pass.

name: Playground
meaning: A playground is next to the road ahead; slow down and watch for children who may run into the street.

name: IN ROAD (Plaque)
meaning: Mounted below the bicycle warning sign, it warns that bicyclists may be riding in the roadway itself; it replaced the SHARE THE ROAD plaque in the 2023 MUTCD.

name: SHARE THE ROAD (Plaque, 2009 MUTCD legacy)
meaning: Legacy plaque from the 2009 MUTCD (replaced in the 2023 edition but still seen on roads and in handbooks) mounted below a bicycle or other warning sign to remind drivers to share the road with those users.

name: Downward Diagonal Arrow (Plaque)
meaning: Mounted below a crossing warning sign (pedestrian, bicycle, trail, etc.), the arrow points to the exact location of the crossing.

name: AHEAD (Plaque)
meaning: Mounted below a warning sign, it shows that the crossing or condition is farther down the road rather than at the sign.

name: Speed Hump
meaning: A raised speed hump crosses the road ahead; slow down before driving over it.

name: Oncoming Traffic Has Extended Green
meaning: Warns left-turning drivers at a signal that oncoming traffic still has a green light after their own signal turns yellow, so they must not assume oncoming traffic is stopping.

name: Oncoming Traffic May Have Extended Green
meaning: Warns left-turning drivers that oncoming traffic sometimes keeps a green light after their own signal turns yellow, so they must not assume oncoming traffic is stopping.

name: Road Work Ahead
meaning: A road work zone is ahead; slow down, stay alert, and watch for workers, equipment, and changing lanes.

name: Detour Ahead
meaning: A detour is ahead; be ready to leave your planned route and follow the orange DETOUR signs.

name: Road Closed (With Distance)
meaning: The road is closed a short distance ahead (distance shown); slow down, prepare to stop, and follow the detour or an alternate route.

name: One Lane Road Ahead
meaning: Ahead, traffic from both directions must share a single lane, usually controlled by flaggers or a temporary signal; slow down and be prepared to stop.

name: Right Lane Closed Ahead
meaning: The right lane is closed ahead; merge into the open lane early and smoothly.

name: Flagger
meaning: A flagger is directing traffic ahead; slow down, be prepared to stop, and obey the flagger's signals.

name: Workers
meaning: Workers are on or near the road ahead; slow down, stay alert, and give them room.

name: Shoulder Work
meaning: Crews are working on the shoulder ahead; slow down, stay in your lane, and watch for workers and equipment.

name: Road Work Next XX Miles
meaning: Posted near the start of a long work zone, it tells drivers how far the road work extends.

name: End Road Work
meaning: Marks the end of the work zone; once past it, resume normal driving and obey the regular posted speed limit.

name: Interstate Route Marker
meaning: Identifies an Interstate highway route; odd-numbered Interstates generally run north-south and even-numbered ones east-west.

name: U.S. Route Marker
meaning: Identifies a U.S. numbered highway (part of the national U.S. Route system).

name: State Route Marker (Generic)
meaning: Identifies a state highway route; each state may use its own marker design, and this is the generic MUTCD version.

name: County Route Marker
meaning: Identifies a county road route (a blue pentagon with a yellow county name and route number).

name: Reference Location Sign (Mile Marker)
meaning: Mile marker showing your location along the route by mile number (counted from the south or west state line or the start of the route), useful for reporting emergencies and tracking distance.

name: Exit Gore Sign
meaning: Placed in the gore where an exit ramp splits from the highway, it marks the exit point, and the arrow shows the direction of the ramp.

name: Exit Number Plaque
meaning: Plaque mounted on top of freeway guide signs giving the interchange's exit number, which is usually based on the nearest mile marker.

name: Destination Sign
meaning: Guide sign showing the direction (arrow) to a city, town, or other destination.

name: Distance Sign
meaning: Guide sign showing the distance in miles to destinations ahead on this route.

name: Street Name Sign
meaning: Identifies the name of the cross street at an intersection.

name: Bike Route
meaning: Marks a designated bicycle route; expect bicyclists using this road.

name: Evacuation Route
meaning: Marks an official evacuation route to follow out of the area during an emergency such as a hurricane.

name: Telephone
meaning: A public telephone is available nearby.

name: Hospital
meaning: A hospital is located nearby; follow these signs to reach it.

name: Accessible Facilities (Handicapped)
meaning: Indicates facilities, such as a rest area or parking, that are accessible to people with disabilities.

name: Gas
meaning: Gasoline (fuel) is available at the next exit or nearby.

name: Food
meaning: Food (restaurants) is available at the next exit or nearby.

name: Lodging
meaning: Lodging (hotels or motels) is available at the next exit or nearby.

name: Rest Area (Advance, With Distance)
meaning: A roadside rest area is ahead at the distance shown.

name: Picnic Area (Recreational Symbol)
meaning: Brown recreational and cultural interest sign showing that a picnic area is nearby.

name: Hiking Trail (Recreational Symbol)
meaning: Brown recreational and cultural interest sign showing that a hiking trail is nearby.

name: Fishing (Recreational Symbol)
meaning: Brown recreational and cultural interest sign showing that a fishing area is nearby.
